svg.title: Pathway network: sedoheptulose bisphosphate bypass
svg.desc: 82 nodes · 67 asserted directed edges. Every arrow links to its evidence table row; nodes link to their component details. Isolated declared components are retained.

a.aria-label: EcoCyc:6PFK-1-CPX — catalyzes → RHEA:31444; subject experimental construct: 2009 six-His ASKA PfkA preparation; assay clone is not asserted sequence-equal to MG1655 P0A796. 2 µM enzyme, S7P 5 mM, ATP 2 mM, potassium MOPS 50 mM, 37 °C, 1 h, n=5. This differs from the 2020 pET-28b/Rosetta preparation.; Evidence PMID:19756045: Methods specify purified six-His ASKA PfkA/FbaA, substrates and enzyme concentrations, ATP, potassium MOPS and the one-hour assay. (XPath /article/body/sec[4]/sec[11]/p[1] | /article/body/sec[4]/sec[11]/p[2]); PfkA with S7P and ATP produces candidate SBP; FbaA-only and no-enzyme controls do not. SBP was quantified with F1,6BP calibration because no authentic standard was available.; Evidence: PMID:19756045, PMID:19756045
a.title: EcoCyc:6PFK-1-CPX — catalyzes → RHEA:31444; subject experimental construct: 2009 six-His ASKA PfkA preparation; assay clone is not asserted sequence-equal to MG1655 P0A796. 2 µM enzyme, S7P 5 mM, ATP 2 mM, potassium MOPS 50 mM, 37 °C, 1 h, n=5. (XPath /article/body/sec[4]/sec[11]/p[1] | /article/body/sec[4]/sec[11]/p[2]); PfkA with S7P and ATP produces candidate SBP; FbaA-only and no-enzyme controls do not. SBP was quantified with F1,6BP calibration because no authentic standard was available.; Evidence: PMID:19756045, PMID:19756045

a.aria-label: EcoCyc:FRUCBISALD-CLASSII — catalyzes → RHEA:30169; subject experimental construct: 2009 six-His ASKA FbaA, 2 µM, assayed with PfkA-generated SBP from S7P 5 mM and ATP 2 mM in potassium MOPS, 37 °C, 1 h, n=5. This is not an isolated native monomer or an authenticated SBP-standard assay.; Evidence PMID:19756045: The primary methods specify the ASKA tagged preparations and conditions for the combined PfkA/FbaA assay. (XPath /article/body/sec[4]/sec[11]/p[1] | /article/body/sec[4]/sec[11]/p[2]); Direct two-enzyme evidence supports SBP cleavage to E4P and DHAP. The no-enzyme, PfkA-only, FbaA-only and F6P comparisons remain distinct; the model supplement and UniProt FUNCTION GAP wording do not replace measured DHAP.; Evidence: PMID:19756045
a.title: EcoCyc:FRUCBISALD-CLASSII — catalyzes → RHEA:30169; subject experimental construct: 2009 six-His ASKA FbaA, 2 µM, assayed with PfkA-generated SBP from S7P 5 mM and ATP 2 mM in potassium MOPS, 37 °C, 1 h, n=5. This is not an isolated native monomer or an authenticated SBP-standard assay.; Evidence PMID:19756045: The primary methods specify the ASKA tagged preparations and conditions for the combined PfkA/FbaA assay. (XPath /article/body/sec[4]/sec[11]/p[1] | /article/body/sec[4]/sec[11]/p[2]); Direct two-enzyme evidence supports SBP cleavage to E4P and DHAP. The no-enzyme, PfkA-only, FbaA-only and F6P comparisons remain distinct; the model supplement and UniProt FUNCTION GAP wording do not replace measured DHAP.; Evidence: PMID:19756045

a.aria-label: EcoCyc:6PFK-1-CPX — catalyzes → RHEA:31444; subject experimental construct: 2020 BW25113_3916 PfkA in pET-28b(+), DH5α cloning and Rosetta His-affinity expression. Coupled55 °C assay uses S7P Ba salt, Mg5 mM, ATP2 mM, ADP0.25 mM and rabbit aldolase/G3PDH/NADH; no added TPI. Distinct from F6P/2009 assays.; Evidence PMID:31871051: The primary methods identify E. coli PfkA cloning, pET-28b expression, His-affinity preparation and coupled kinase conditions; S7P is supplied as its Ba salt. (XPath /article/body/sec[5]/sec[3]/p[1] | /article/body/sec[5]/sec[3]/p[3] | /article/body/sec[5]/sec[7]/p[2] | /article/body/sec[5]/sec[7]/p[1]); Independent 2020 S7P kinase capacity under a 55 °C coupled assay. Coupling enzymes, NADH and suspected trace TPI are detection context, not new pathway events. Thesis Figure S4 presents both Michaelis–Menten and Hill fits; neither establishes physiological cooperativity of bypass flux.; Evidence: PMID:31871051

a.aria-label: CHEBI:49786 — inhibits → EcoCyc:FRUCBISALD-CLASSII; object experimental construct: 2011 untagged FbaA purified from MG1655/pLEM1 (pWKS30), ≥70% purity; canonical FBP coupled activity. In-vitro challenge: 50 mM Tris-HCl pH7.5, aerobic25 °C. Separate pLEM5 His6 WT/mutant controls are not pooled into this preparation.; Evidence PMID:22014167: Methods distinguish untagged pLEM1 purification from His-tagged pLEM5 WT/mutants, and specify the aerobic Tris-buffer challenge assay. (XPath /collection/document/passage[40] | /collection/document/passage[50] | /collection/document/passage[52]); Time- and concentration-dependent inhibition; Zn-site substitution is supported, not direct SBP kinetics. Calcium, Mg and Mn had no effect in the same comparison; those negatives do not refute activity of separately substituted metalloproteins.; Evidence: PMID:22014167
